procedure.setup: Run tools/check.sh once in the clean detached worktree to complete atlas generation and Godot import before capturing plans.
procedure.capture: For each N from 4 through 8, run TEST_SHARDS=N ./tools/test.sh --plan and capture stdout and stderr.
procedure.validation: Reject ERROR:, SCRIPT ERROR, Parse Error, and Failed to open output; compare the planned suite names with all tests/test_*.gd files; reject missing or duplicate suites.

rejected_initial_capture.reason: The first plan capture also performed initial atlas and Godot setup, so its output contained log-file failures and class-registry parse errors before the import completed. It is not accepted as clean verification evidence.
